metadata.name: Organic History Earth Global 4000 BCE v1
metadata.description: Large Earth 4000 BCE organic-history fixture with initial ancient cores and command-gated dynamic civilization emergence metadata.

generationMode: freeciv-server lua edit APIs plus scensave

historicalGravity.principle: Historical roles are pressure and opportunity, not scripted destiny. Mechanics must be condition-gated, avoidable through good management, and probabilistic when pressure is high.

examples.rome: A Rome with strong Italy/core control, good cohesion, and restrained frontier overreach should avoid collapse pressure.
examples.china: A high-mandate, unified China should continue or reform instead of always being replaced by Song or Ming.
examples.new_world: Aztec/Inca outcomes after contact should vary with development, diplomacy, geography, and preparedness.

mechanicSeparation.historicalDataRole: Defines claims, niches, successor identities, expected pressures, and flavor.
mechanicSeparation.mechanicTriggerRole: Generic mechanics decide whether current overextension, mandate, core control, contact, war, or economy conditions justify pressure.
mechanicSeparation.forbiddenPattern: Do not fire events only because an actor and calendar date match history.

initial_core.description: Original 4000 BCE cores that should face pressure, reform, contraction, and successors rather than simple scripted death.

imperial_claimant.description: Expansion-oriented land empires that need enough early agency to reach regional scale before collapse pressure matters.

dynastic_successor.description: Successor identities that should often transform or inherit from predecessors instead of appearing as weak one-city rivals.

maritime_trader.description: Coastal trade and colonial powers that need ships, settlers, and coastal pressure rather than inland empire behavior.

steppe_conqueror.description: Mobile steppe polities that should get burst potential against rich, fragmented, under-defended neighbors.

island_core.description: Island civilizations that need durable island setup and protection from premature extinction.

tribal_horizon.description: Broad cultural/tribal horizons that should exert regional pressure without necessarily becoming durable centralized empires.

regional_kingdom.description: Regional powers that should consolidate a local core without necessarily becoming world empires.

nubian_regional_kingdom.description: Upper Nile regional kingdom that should keep a compact core and shed excess peripheral expansion more readily than generic regional powers.

startsNotes: Coordinates are in the 160x90 earth-large native coordinate space.
This fixture intentionally starts with early ancient cores only; later civilizations emerge through command-gated Lua mechanics.
Dynamic emergence is probabilistic and gated by organic_history_emergence_enabled.
timelineNotes: The Lua emergence table currently mirrors this metadata directly.
Emergence is command-gated by organic_history_emergence_enabled and probabilistic through organic_history_emergence_probability.
Turn windows are first-pass gameplay scaffolding, not final historical dates.
